## 1) Packages

```{r packages}
required_pkgs <- c("dplyr", "ggplot2", "tibble")
missing_pkgs <- required_pkgs[!vapply(required_pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  stop("Missing R packages: ", paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", "))
}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
```

## 2) Inputs

```{r inputs}
anchor_path <- "D:/Codex/Test/external/SCORE/examples/data/mm10.genome_split_1M"
raw_pair_dir <- "D:/Codex/Test/external/SCORE/examples/data/oocyte_zygote_mm10/1M"
nb_pair_dir  <- "D:/Codex/Test/data/bhzip_score_compare_from_pairs/bhzip_1M"
nm_pair_dir  <- "D:/Codex/Test/data/bhzip_score_compare_from_pairs_nm/bhzip_nm_1M"
schic_pair_dir <- "D:/Codex/Test/data/schicimpute_score_compare_from_pairs/schicimpute_1M"

target_chr <- "chr1"
requested_cell <- NULL
kernel_shape <- 3L
random_walk_ratio <- 1.0
random_walk_steps <- 1L
raw_cap_quantile <- 0.99
schi_cap_quantile <- 0.96
```

## 3) Helpers

```{r helpers}
read_pair_file <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path) || file.info(path)$size == 0) return(NULL)
  x <- tryCatch(
    read.table(path, sep = "\t", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(x) || nrow(x) == 0 || ncol(x) < 3) return(NULL)
  x <- x[, 1:3]
  colnames(x) <- c("bin1", "bin2", "count")
  x$bin1 <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(x$bin1))
  x$bin2 <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(x$bin2))
  x$count <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x$count))
  x <- x[!is.na(x$bin1) & !is.na(x$bin2) & !is.na(x$count), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(x) == 0) return(NULL)
  x
}

pick_example_cell <- function(dirs, requested_cell = NULL) {
  available <- dirs[dir.exists(dirs)]
  if (length(available) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  file_sets <- lapply(available, function(d) list.files(d, full.names = FALSE))
  common <- Reduce(intersect, file_sets)
  if (length(common) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  if (!is.null(requested_cell) && requested_cell %in% common) return(requested_cell)
  sort(common)[1]
}

build_chr_mat <- function(pair_dir, cell_file, chr_ids) {
  n_bins <- length(chr_ids)
  f <- file.path(pair_dir, cell_file)
  d <- read_pair_file(f)
  if (is.null(d)) return(matrix(0, nrow = n_bins, ncol = n_bins))

  keep <- d$bin1 %in% chr_ids & d$bin2 %in% chr_ids
  d <- d[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(matrix(0, nrow = n_bins, ncol = n_bins))

  old2new <- integer(max(chr_ids) + 1L)
  old2new[chr_ids + 1L] <- seq_len(n_bins)
  i <- old2new[d$bin1 + 1L]
  j <- old2new[d$bin2 + 1L]
  ok <- i > 0 & j > 0 & !is.na(i) & !is.na(j)
  i <- i[ok]
  j <- j[ok]
  w <- d$count[ok]
  if (length(i) == 0) return(matrix(0, nrow = n_bins, ncol = n_bins))

  mat <- matrix(0, nrow = n_bins, ncol = n_bins)
  for (k in seq_along(i)) {
    ii <- i[k]
    jj <- j[k]
    mat[ii, jj] <- mat[ii, jj] + w[k]
    if (ii != jj) mat[jj, ii] <- mat[jj, ii] + w[k]
  }
  mat
}

vc_sqrt_norm <- function(mat) {
  sm <- colSums(mat)
  sm[sm == 0] <- 1
  sm <- sqrt(sm)
  denom <- tcrossprod(sm, sm)
  mat / denom
}

convolution_mean <- function(mat, kernel_shape = 3L) {
  stopifnot(kernel_shape %% 2L == 1L)
  pad <- (kernel_shape - 1L) %/% 2L
  nr <- nrow(mat)
  nc <- ncol(mat)
  padded <- matrix(0, nrow = nr + 2L * pad, ncol = nc + 2L * pad)
  padded[(pad + 1L):(pad + nr), (pad + 1L):(pad + nc)] <- mat
  out <- matrix(0, nrow = nr, ncol = nc)
  denom <- kernel_shape^2
  for (i in seq_len(nr)) {
    for (j in seq_len(nc)) {
      out[i, j] <- sum(padded[i:(i + 2L * pad), j:(j + 2L * pad)]) / denom
    }
  }
  out
}

random_walk_smooth <- function(mat, random_walk_ratio = 1.0, t = 1L) {
  sm <- rowSums(mat)
  sm[sm == 0] <- 1
  walk <- mat / sm
  out <- mat
  for (step in seq_len(t)) {
    out <- random_walk_ratio * (out %*% walk) + (1 - random_walk_ratio) * out
  }
  out
}

mat_to_df <- function(mat, panel_label) {
  n <- nrow(mat)
  expand.grid(i = seq_len(n), j = seq_len(n), KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      value = as.numeric(mat[cbind(i, j)]),
      log_value = log1p(value),
      panel = panel_label
    )
}
```

## 4) Build Raw and scHiCluster Matrices

```{r build}
anchors <- read.delim(anchor_path, sep = "\t", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(anchors) <- c("chr", "start", "end", "idx0")
chr_ids <- anchors$idx0[anchors$chr == target_chr]

cell_file <- pick_example_cell(
  c(raw_pair_dir, nb_pair_dir, nm_pair_dir, schic_pair_dir),
  requested_cell = requested_cell
)

if (is.na(cell_file)) {
  stop("Could not find a common cell file across the comparison directories.")
}

raw_mat <- build_chr_mat(raw_pair_dir, cell_file, chr_ids)
vc_mat <- vc_sqrt_norm(raw_mat)
conv_mat <- convolution_mean(vc_mat, kernel_shape = kernel_shape)
schicluster_mat <- random_walk_smooth(
  conv_mat,
  random_walk_ratio = random_walk_ratio,
  t = random_walk_steps
)

cat("Cell:", cell_file, "\n")
cat("Chromosome:", target_chr, "\n")
cat("n_bins:", length(chr_ids), "\n")
cat("Raw nonzero:", sum(raw_mat > 0), "\n")
cat("scHiCluster nonzero:", sum(schicluster_mat > 0), "\n")
```

## 5) Heatmaps

```{r heatmap, fig.width=16, fig.height=6}
heat_df <- bind_rows(
  mat_to_df(raw_mat, "Raw"),
  mat_to_df(vc_mat, "VC sqrt norm"),
  mat_to_df(conv_mat, "VC sqrt norm + convolution"),
  mat_to_df(schicluster_mat, "scHiCluster final")
) %>%
  mutate(
    panel = factor(
      panel,
      levels = c("Raw", "VC sqrt norm", "VC sqrt norm + convolution", "scHiCluster final")
    )
  )

raw_df <- heat_df %>% filter(panel == "Raw")
schi_df <- heat_df %>% filter(panel != "Raw")

raw_cap <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(raw_df$log_value[is.finite(raw_df$log_value)], raw_cap_quantile, na.rm = TRUE))
if (!is.finite(raw_cap)) raw_cap <- 1

schi_cap <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(schi_df$log_value[is.finite(schi_df$log_value)], schi_cap_quantile, na.rm = TRUE))
if (!is.finite(schi_cap)) schi_cap <- 1

p_raw <- ggplot(raw_df, aes(x = j, y = i, fill = log_value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    limits = c(0, raw_cap),
    oob = scales::squish,
    name = "log1p(raw count)"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(
    title = paste0("scHiCluster Heatmap Diagnostic | ", target_chr, " | cell: ", cell_file),
    subtitle = "Raw uses its own scale; scHiCluster preprocessing steps use a separate transformed-value scale",
    x = "bin",
    y = "bin"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

p_schi <- ggplot(schi_df, aes(x = j, y = i, fill = log_value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    limits = c(0, schi_cap),
    oob = scales::squish,
    name = "transformed\nlog1p"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(
    title = "scHiCluster preprocessing stages",
    subtitle = "Same chromosome and same cell-selection logic as extract_paper_metrics_external_impute_plus_standalone.Rmd",
    x = "bin",
    y = "bin"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p_raw)
print(p_schi)
```

## 6) Save Figure

```{r save}
out_dir <- "D:/Codex/Test/downloaded_results/paper_metrics_external_impute_plus_standalone"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "schicluster_heatmap_same_cell_chr_raw.png"),
  plot = p_raw,
  width = 6,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 220
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "schicluster_heatmap_same_cell_chr_transformed.png"),
  plot = p_schi,
  width = 14,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 220
)

cat("Saved figures to:", out_dir, "\n")
```
